company.description:
Yuga Labs is a blockchain technology company that develops NFTs and digital collectibles. It specializes in the fields of blockchain, cryptocurrency, and digital media.

Yuga Labs was founded in 2021 by Wylie Aronow and Greg Solano and headquartered in Miami, Florida.

aiResearchSummary.text: Yuga Labs is researching blockchain-based protocols for metadata linkage control, as described in the work on cryptographic containers and on-chain modules. The focus includes systems and methods for responding to disruptions in on-chain metadata linkage, confirming speculative on-chain module linkages, and enhancing autonomy in blockchain environments. These efforts highlight Yuga Labs’ development in secure and resilient NFT and digital collectible infrastructure.
